paper.title: A Data-Driven Evolutionary Algorithm for Wind Farm Layout Optimization

paper_problem.decision_variables: continuous x-y coordinates for a fixed number of identical turbines
paper_problem.wake_model: Jensen top-hat, root-sum-square multiple-wake deficit, wake-reduced Weibull scale
paper_problem.wind_scenarios: Tables 4 and 5: 24 fifteen-degree direction bins with direction-conditioned Weibull parameters

missing_and_declared_completions.completion: use the two complete direction-conditioned tables printed in the paper
use 21 equal 0.5 m/s midpoint bins over [3.5,14), plus the analytic rated-power interval
sort turbines by x then y and normalize coordinates by farm side; raw metres with sigma 0.01 numerically underflow
use a deterministic FIFO capacity equal to the population, 40
halve the difference displacement at most 40 times, then retain the parent
publish deterministic counter-keyed streams and five explicit independent seeds per case

paper_conflicts.fact: the printed [330,315) interval is invalid and duplicates a later lower bound
Equation 2 derives k from an unreported surface roughness while Table 1 explicitly gives k=0.01
paper_conflicts.resolution: use the paper table value k=0.01

hpc.executor: one persistent all-core team per optimization
hpc.data_layout: contiguous GRNN feature matrix with vectorizable coordinate distance kernels
hpc.determinism: counter-keyed random events, fixed-index parallel writes, stable ranking, ordered state commits
hpc.non_oversubscription: one formal run owns at most all twenty Waffle CPU workers

claim_boundary: Academic paper-equation and lifecycle reconstruction; not author code, raw-data replay, original random bitstream, or exact numerical replay.
